description: Create a new state (status condition like Poison/Sleep) in data/States.json. Only `name` is required; omitted fields use the editor's new-state defaults (no restriction, priority 50, no auto-removal, 1-turn duration). Allocates and returns the next unused state id.

autoRemovalTiming.description: Auto-removal timing: 0 none, 1 at action end, 2 at turn end

chanceByDamage.description: Chance (%) of removal per damage instance when removeByDamage

dryRun.description: Preview only: return a diff of what would change without writing to disk.

iconIndex.description: Icon shown on the battler/status (0 = none)

maxTurns.description: Maximum duration in turns when auto-removed

message1.description: Message when an actor gains the state

message2.description: Message when an enemy gains the state

message4.description: Message when the state is removed

minTurns.description: Minimum duration in turns when auto-removed

name.description: State name shown in the database and battle messages

releaseByDamage.description: Whether damage can release the state

removeAtBattleEnd.description: Remove automatically when the battle ends

removeByDamage.description: Remove when the battler takes damage

removeByRestriction.description: Remove when the battler's restriction changes

removeByWalking.description: Remove after walking a number of steps

restriction.description: Behavior restriction: 0 none, 1 attack enemy, 2 attack anyone, 3 attack ally, 4 cannot move

stepsToRemove.description: Steps to walk off the state when removeByWalking

name: create_state
